pass_results.pass_summary: Found 1 critical (credential storage), 6 high/medium severity issues (XXE, path traversal, DoS via JSON, insecure session formats, header injection, file handling), and 3 low severity items (output encoding, config injection). Primary concerns are unencrypted credential storage in plaintext session files and potential path traversal in file operations.

Found 11 infrastructure and configuration security issues: 2 high severity (plaintext credentials in sessions, path traversal in downloads), 6 medium severity (insecure directory permissions, certificate validation bypasses, missing HSTS support, verbose error logging, proxy credentials, download timeouts), and 3 low severity (debug info exposure, lack of rate limiting, missing response header validation).
